ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only a joining word

3. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. where is the library

4. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

5. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

6. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

7. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

8. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. happiness
   C. run
   D. quickly

10. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.

11. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

13. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. goed
   D. went

14. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.

15. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
